selected_entrant: MatchPoint with Compact96 VALUE and CFR150k SELF_PLAY
units: Big blinds per played hand. Each duplicate deal is played twice with seats reversed.
points: Win = 1, chop = 0.5, loss = 0. A 95% interval spanning zero gives a chop.
intervals: Normal 95% intervals over per-deal returns. For field differences the same-deal chip gains are averaged across the opponent set before estimating uncertainty.

training.target: Predict the return gain of each legal action over the base action from paired Monte Carlo rollouts.
training.split: Group by deal ID; 20% held out, split seed 7721. Export the selected validation epoch for the neural fits.

boosted.algorithm: CPU gradient-boosted decision trees per action

selection_screens.caveat: The three neural widths and boosted trees share sweep seeds. Selection among candidates requires a fresh confirmation.

public_practice.transport: unclocked public practice; fresh peer interpreter for each half
caveats: Ten frozen historical peer reports retain only aggregate scores. The field mean gap is descriptive.
Clock-sensitive peer sampling and fallbacks can change on identical deals. Compare the ShortStackSage fallback counts.
Quad-J and RangeRunner use separately matched seeds and retain the per-deal paired comparison.

selected_router_evaluation.selection: The router earned an additional hard-field point, preserved all twelve public points and finished the restricted Linux referee match cleanly.

public_field.transport: sequential local unclocked callback matches; original peer internal clocks preserved
public_field.method: Average peer differences within shared deal seed before computing the field standard error.
public_field.caveat: Ten peers adapt their sampling to runtime, and ShortStackShark also uses unseeded randomness.

strict_linux_clock.provenance: Frozen MatchPoint v2 image staged with byte-identical Compact96 and CFR150k weights in its original model slots. Standalone release archive attestation is recorded separately.

ensemble_and_runout_rmse_study.interval: Percentile 95% interval of 1,000 paired deal-cluster bootstrap replicates, including both seats and all streets.
ensemble_and_runout_rmse_study.runout_smoothing: One branch averaged alternative all-in board runouts before training.

linux.environment: Official referee, Linux Docker, Python 3.12, 1 CPU and 4 GiB per bot, read-only root, no GPU.

windows.environment: Windows Python 3.12.5; loaded laptop, one-CPU affinity; official referee.

prior_sandbox_attempt.detail: A separate Windows attempt failed to establish the local connection before startup timed out. No match was played.

boosted_check.environment: Separate restricted Linux HTTP test. The two bots and referee shared one vCPU.
boosted_check.startup_measurement: Startup durations were not recorded per role.

residual_action_value_study.method: Two hidden ReLU layers learn corrections to chip-valued priors for folds, calls and both raises. Inputs contain the 28 compact features, per-street betting line, compact blocker and draw counts, pot/equity interactions and the priors.
residual_action_value_study.selection: Freeze the lowest unweighted original-validation RMSE before opening the independent replay.
residual_action_value_study.uncertainty: Paired delta-method normal intervals cluster by replay deal ID. The targets include stochastic future cards and actions. A smaller return-prediction error does not guarantee more match points.

final_value_studies.selection: Minimum original validation RMSE among the completed fits nominated scaled residual96 for the one-candidate blind test. Its seven-style field tied on points and its two direct matches were chops. Compact96 remains the played VALUE policy.

field.reference: Current Compact96 VALUE with CFR150k SELF_PLAY
Current Compact96 VALUE with CFR150k SELF_PLAY

fit.architecture: four related two-layer 64-wide MLPs, independent outputs

final_value_studies.gap_interpretation: Training loss is accumulated on stochastic minibatches while updating weights; validation uses the end-of-epoch checkpoint. Extra smoothed and mixed-profile training rows in the scaled study have a different target distribution.

sealed_comparison.units: chips per legal action gain relative to each model's own predicted base action
sealed_comparison.primary: Difference in all-legal-action RMSE across all streets, nominee minus Compact96.
sealed_comparison.uncertainty: Paired percentile bootstrap over all generated deals, keeping both seats, all actions and streets together. Per-street intervals are descriptive and unadjusted.
